decision_rule: Do not admit to PPO unless fixed-batch action dependence, behavior retention, reset or zero-response degradation, and hidden-envelope retention all hold.
failure_criteria: normal actions drift away from M98 or M62 on retained behavior states
reset or zero-response actions remain indistinguishable from normal actions
objective uses hidden physical parameters or oracle feasibility actor inputs
hypothesis: A fixed-batch actor-coupling objective can make the actor use M98's hidden-envelope belief more directly than PPO plus a weak action-contrast term.
success_criteria: starts from an M98 strict objective-pass checkpoint
preserves normal-history actions under an action anchor
increases normal-vs-reset action divergence on fixed batches
retains M62-level behavior on shared-seed benchmark
normal recurrent behavior beats reset and zero-response ablations
